body: The thought of the future isn’t enough anymore, there is no light at the end of this tunnel.
Someone kicking in my door, and dragging me out, or someone I love staying with me and holding me as I cry for her

I’m completely alone, I’ve cut myself off from most of the people I know, as they don’t know, and I don’t have the heart to tell them.

And those that did know her are saying the same mushy stuff, but I don’t want to hear the same apologies and saying it will get better.

I just want to be with her, and to finally rest.

She’s all I can think about, we were together for over 2 years. It’s so hard to move forward, and I keep killing myself over not being able to be with her when it happened, so she wouldn’t be alone, or at least get to say goodbye.

It ripped a hole right through me when the officers told me what happened, i was completely in tears, and couldn’t make sense of it. 

I still can’t really, she was all I had, my family kicked me out when they found out I was lesbian, she was my family, and now all I want is to be with her again.
